en: Old black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large historic church with a tall tower and spire topped by a cross, a clock on the tower, and a steeply pitched roof decorated with a diamond pattern. Smaller houses adjoin the church, with bare trees, a fenced yard, and a pond or water feature in the foreground. The image edges are worn and damaged, giving it an early-20th‑century appearance.
